01运行前的观察目标02注册通用投影模块，验证更新与独立快照恢复03代码说明

运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

参数名包含 layers 与 head；Buffer 包含 feature_mean 与 feature_scale；投影参数实际更新，新实例从独立快照恢复更新前的四维输出。

python 36_modules_demo.py环境配置

注册通用投影模块，验证更新与独立快照恢复

36_modules_demo.py
# [1] 统计量作为 Buffer，多个层使用 ModuleListimport copyimport torchfrom torch import nntorch.manual_seed(17) class FeatureProjector(nn.Module):    def __init__(self, dim=8):        super().__init__()        self.register_buffer("feature_mean", torch.zeros(dim))        self.register_buffer("feature_scale", torch.ones(dim))        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(dim, dim), nn.Linear(dim, dim)])        self.head = nn.Linear(dim, 4)     def forward(self, x):        x = (x - self.feature_mean) / self.feature_scale.clamp_min(1e-6)        for layer in self.layers:            x = torch.nn.functional.gelu(layer(x))        return self.head(x) # [2] 全部模块构造完毕之后再创建优化器model = FeatureProjector()optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)x = torch.randn(4, 8)before_output = model(x).detach().clone()snapshot = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())before_weight = model.head.weight.detach().clone()assert "layers.0.weight" in snapshotassert "feature_mean" in snapshotassert "feature_mean" not in dict(model.named_parameters()) # [3] 更新后，独立快照仍能恢复旧的函数optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)model(x).square().mean().backward()optimizer.step()assert not torch.equal(model.head.weight, before_weight)restored = FeatureProjector()restored.load_state_dict(snapshot)torch.testing.assert_close(restored(x), before_output)print("参数名:", list(dict(model.named_parameters())))print("Buffer:", list(dict(model.named_buffers())))print("注册与独立快照检查通过")
